replication.target_description: Current UCC archival replication; timing of first NOT alert among clients who alerted at least once, group-only versus individual-only therapy; one-way ANOVA in Evaluating Timing of First Alerts and Table 2. Supplied Table 1 locator concerns rate and conflicts with timing description; substantive description uniquely identifies timing analysis.

n.sample_role: Clients with at least one NOT alert in mutually exclusive individual-only (1,214) and group-only (46) samples, contributing first-alert timing.
n.exclusions: Valid OQ-45 administrations with more than two data points; individual/group therapy only; other treatment types excluded; first episode only (90-day gap defines new episode); concurrent group/individual therapy excluded; alerts examined during Sessions 2–15. Timing additionally excludes never-alerting clients.

notes: Identity independently checked: matching title (L70–72), authors Alldredge, Burlingame, Olsen, Van Epps (L74–80), DOI 10.1037/gdn0000121 (L198), journal/year. Full primary research report frozen as ResearchGate numbered text parse, including Method, Results, Discussion, Conclusions and References; advance pagination differs from final pagination. No PDF supplied. Provenance explicitly says equals signs are rendered as !; operators interpreted accordingly, quotes retain canonical glyphs. Original is an unassigned placeholder. 1,214 individual-only alerting clients + 46 group-only alerting clients = 1,260 clients in first-alert timing analysis; explicit Figure 3 client counts and Table 1 alerting counts, not df. Matched by timing outcome and formats independently of input order or numeric correspondence. Supplied Table 1 locator is a discrepancy: Table 1 is frequency, whereas timing has its own subsection and Table 2. No OR printed for this timing comparison; retain printed F=3.55 and same-test p=.060 without conversion. Table 1 separately gives rate chi-square=7.25, p=.007, and text gives relative risk 1.43, p=.004; these are not timing effects or odds ratios. Timing means 4.70 and 5.52 are also printed. Authors explicitly state timing did not replicate, while noting low power and that the jury is out; failed codes the narrative nonreplication, not an inference from significance.
